## Description

"This is a pre-main amplifier that has inherited the tradition since Point One.The power amplifier employs a pure complimentary service OCL stage and a constant current drive class A driver stage. By applying a deep and stable DC NFB, it is designed to operate stably without being affected by temperature changes, load fluctuations, shock noise, etc.A protective circuit is provided to protect the speakers and output transistors in the event of an accident such as output terminal short-circuit or excessive input.A circuit with differential inputs is used for the equalizer stage, and the DC NFB is applied to the overall stage so that it is shock-resistant and stable.It is equipped with functions such as a BTL circuit that can produce monaural output with a single switch, and a speaker matrix switch that can produce a hall tone effect."

description:
## Description

"A two way speaker system that uses a sandwich cone.A 17cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.For the cone, we have adopted a sandwich cone made by sandwiching thin polystyrene cone with uniformly stretched aluminum foil.In addition, it uses a low distortion suspension and a long slow magnet that withstands large amplitude to ensure stable playback even at large input.A 3cm cone type tweeter is used for the high range.The cone is made of plastic, and by winding a coil directly around the neck of the cone, strain is kept low.The network uses a filter of 18cm/oct. with an emphasis on phase characteristics in the mid-range."

description:
## Description

"A 3-way speaker system developed as a successor to Sandwich300.A 20cm sandwich corn woofer is used for the low range.In this unit, a sticky material is used to dump around the voice coil to prevent distortion.It uses a 10cm plastic cone type unit for the middle area, and the cone is coated with sticky dump material.In addition, specially shaped holes are made in the cone paper to minimize coloring of the playback sound.A tweeter with a 2.5cm polyester film dome is used for the high range.Directivity is improved because the area of the vibrator is small."

description:
## Description

"This 3-way floor type speaker system was developed with the aim of flat response and precise reproduction power.A 30cm sandwich cone woofer is used for the low range.By dumping the roll edge with adhesive material, generation of strain is suppressed.A 10cm plastic cone type unit is used for the middle area.It uses a perforated structure and is the same as the one used in 2030.A plastic dome type tweeter of 2.5cm, which is the same size as 2030, is used for the high range.The enclosure is hand-finished and the cabinet has resonance protection, especially since the lower frequency limit of the woofer is low.Plywood with a thickness of 18mm is used for the material, and asphalt dump material with a thickness of 15mm is used for the inside."
